definitions.explanation: The quality of being bitter in taste. Used when discussing flavors in food, drink, and cooking. One of the five basic tastes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苦味|にがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This coffee has a strong bitterness.

examples.japanese: ゴーヤ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦味|にがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people dislike the bitterness of bitter melon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧、{苦味|にがみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently, many people come to enjoy bitter-tasting foods as they grow older.

notes:
USAGE:
{苦味|にがみ} refers specifically to the bitter component of a flavor. It is one of the five basic tastes alongside ⟦{甘味|あまみ}→甘味：07017_amami⟧ (sweetness), ⟦{酸味|さんみ}→酸味：07016_sanmi⟧ (sourness), ⟦{塩味|しおみ}→塩味：25472_shiomi⟧ (saltiness), and ⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧ (umami).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦味|にがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strongly bitter)
- {苦味|にがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (taste bitterness)
- {苦味|にがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いている→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (the bitterness comes through)
- {苦味|にがみ}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧ (bitter component)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {苦|にが}さ: bitterness (general quality, can be figurative — bitterness of experience)
- {渋味|しぶみ}: astringency (puckering taste, as in unripe persimmon or strong tea)
- ⟦{酸味|さんみ}→酸味：07016_sanmi⟧: sourness, acidity (another taste quality)
